ev_0005.summary: Circle_01 has center O (224.4,222.0) and radius 157.3 px. A (66.9,222.0) and B (381.5,222.0) lie on it, so AB is a horizontal diameter through O, drawn solid, and O is its midpoint. C (210.6,65.8), D (360.7,143.7) and C' (237.8,379.1) are on the circle. C, O and C' are collinear within about 0.2 degrees and |CC'| = 314.5 px, which matches the diameter 2r = 314.6, so CC' is a diameter. P (270.9,222.7) lies on AB between O and B, but it is not on the circle. Verified style: segment C-P solid (CV seg_03), O-C dashed (seg_04), O-C' solid (seg_05), and a dashed chain D-C' (seg_02). CV's seg_02 runs from D to C', not O to D, so the supervisor's O-D claim has no line evidence. Likewise, no CV segment supports O-P dashed (AB is solid across it) or P-C' dashed. No right angle is claimed at O.
